design_fidelity.notes: One observer drives finite geometry and infinite sky; native materials explicitly diagnostic, production painted renderer retained. Actual openings and separate walk domains avoid teleporting through floors. No new relativity formulas/simulation state changes. GR consistently stated unimplemented. Runtime creates collision for all visual meshes, broader than the active-section-only proposal; acceptable for this bounded blockout but merits resource tuning before detailed architecture.
